''See also: [[Penance arrow Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Penance]] arrow is a specialized projectile characterized by its lethal and sentient qualities. Unlike standard weaponry, these arrows possess the ability to actively track their intended targets. They carry an intense, death-like energy that can cause physical numbness or a sensation of imminent mortality upon contact. This power is so potent that even touching the arrow can feel like a surge of dark lightning, threatening the user's very life. The arrows are rare, with limited quantities available to a wielder, and they can be enhanced through the use of force and time circles to increase their speed. They are capable of being fired from powerful implements, such as the [[Eclipse]] bow.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|During a confrontation, a [[Penance]] arrow struck an [[Abidan panel]] of blue light and vanished, only to be replaced by a volley of bone arrows. The projectile subsequently thundered through space and [[Fate]] toward [[Reigan Shen]]. Later, [[Lindon]] nocked a [[Penance]] arrow, an object capable of scraping at the user's lifeline and causing a sensation of death upon contact. When the power of the arrow numbed [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s hand, it was being accelerated by a circle of force and time.}}
